summary: The mounted leocrotta eats a small-mimic corpse. C dogmove.c:quickmimic() dismounts the steed with DISMOUNT_POLY before choosing the mimic appearance; the first missing call enters steed.c:landing_spot() at step 169. JavaScript dog_eat() instead records the dismount as unported and returns from its m_consume_obj callback, while quickmimic() separately refuses a steed.

source.branch: Tame pet consumes a mimic corpse while it is the hero's steed: quickmimic must call dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) before consuming random choices or changing the mimic appearance.
callers: dogmove.c:dog_eat() -> mon.c:m_consume_obj() -> quickmimic() after a tame pet eats a mimic corpse

evidence: challenges/evaluations/admission-979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e-v66.json: the accepted-source baseline records 169/221 screens, 2788/2866 RNG calls, and 176/221 cursors matched; the first mismatch is step 169, C landing_spot(steed.c:543) rn2(2)=1 versus JS rn2(5)=0.

nethack-c/upstream/src/dogmove.c:1478-1488: quickmimic() returns only for shape-changer protection or when the monster is not eating; for the steed it calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) before the mimic-choice rn2 loop.
js/dogmove.js:666-678: dog_eat() passes a quickMimic callback to mon.c:m_consume_obj(); the callback currently records note_unported('steed.c dismount_steed') and returns for the steed.
js/dogmove.js:703-722: quickmimic() separately throws for a steed before entering its random-choice loop.
js/steed.js:880-965: an existing dismount_steed() implementation handles DISMOUNT_POLY and landing_spot().

/tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-pE3Yn4/receipt.json: current cd3a25bc56078f864660a69ad6b7856706816bd4 replay completed successfully; 221 screens emitted; step-169 screen, RNG and cursor mismatch matches the saved baseline.

resolution.sourceFinding: The baseline mismatch entered steed.c:landing_spot because dogmove.c:quickmimic must call dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) before its appearance-choice RNG. A separate independent recipe exposed a planner-only duplicate: dog_eat() replayed its quickMimic callback while predicting the monster turn, which dismounted the live steed and wrote its message before execution. The callback now returns during planning for the live steed; execution then follows quickmimic() source order.
resolution.implementation: dogmove.c:dog_eat() and quickmimic() now preserve the planning boundary and execute the steed dismount before mimic-choice RNG.
